gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-carian: Expose packs its capitals and lowercase tightly, with hardly a breath between lines of letters. Noto Sans Carian keeps its terminals apart and its strokes uncrowded, so extended reading goes down smoothly after that dense, striking top.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Expose is striking and refined, its capitals and lowercase packed close in a compressed rhythm. And Noto Sans Kaithi brings a modern, open-channelled e, whose lowercase fills the line like capitals, which is the pair's real hook.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Expose sets a compressed, refined tone, with caps barely above its lowercase. Noto Sans Kayah Li is happiest when you give its text a little extra size, since its lifted brush ends and tidy capitals reward a bit of room.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Expose is striking and tightly compressed, a display face that makes a headline feel decisive. Noto Sans Khudawadi does the opposite job, offering approachable text with unsealed rounds and little height difference between capitals and lowercase.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-kr: Generous gaps in the curves and a big, stubby-ascender build make Noto Sans KR feel open and contemporary. And Expose sits above it as the tight, refined voice, so the page moves from compressed drama to easy text.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Almost no gap separates Expose's capitals from its lowercase, giving it a compressed, striking look. Noto Sans Marchen is the roomier partner, with tall small letters and curves that end in clear daylight, built for steady reading rather than display.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numeral: Striking is the first word for Expose, whose caps and lowercase crowd together in a tight, refined cadence. But Noto Sans Mayan Numerals loosens things up with tall-bodied small letters and a visibly gaping c, a contemporary text voice.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Tight, sharp and polished: that is Expose, with barely any pause between letter heights. But Noto Sans Meroitic gives the eye room, with see-through c openings and lowercase that fills the line like capitals.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-mro: Refined is the word for Expose, a compressed display face with hardly a gap between its lowercase and caps. Noto Sans Mro feels tall and dense in the middle of words, yet its wide entrances keep it modern beside that tight neighbour.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-multani: Noto Sans Multani has a lofty x-height and an e that opens wide at its terminal. Expose feels tighter and more striking next to it, with its compressed cadence making the body's modern openness stand out.
